items.title: STRAT 392: needs about 84% on the last 190 points to avoid an E
items.note: With the midterm at zero and a 60% final, STRAT lands near 61.6% (D-). Dropping below 60% means an E and zero credits, which breaks the 126 credit total. The remaining 190 points are the 8 reading quizzes, the Market Entry Lab (60) and the Strategy Journal (50). Holding 84% or better on those keeps the course at a D- or better.
